name: Maria Antonia DiBiasi

events.title: Alive in Aug 1934
events.description: Named as mother 'Mary', maiden name 'Bibisi', born Italy, residing Scranton, housewife, on son Charles's marriage-license application.

bioAdditions: Son Charles's marriage-license application of August 1934 names his mother as 'Mary', maiden name 'Bibisi' (a clerk's rendering of DiBiasi), born in Italy and living in Scranton (S1). This is a third independent record of her maiden name after the 1931 and 1941 licenses, and it shows her alive less than a year before her 5 July 1935 death. The 1940 census of the Bunker Hill Street block shows a widowed Vincenzo DiBiasi, 74, born in Italy, owning no. 1022, three doors from the Petriello house at no. 1028 (S2). He was born c.1866, so he is a plausible brother or cousin of Maria Antonia. The two households of DiBiasis at no. 1022 are a lead for her family, not a proven link.
openQuestionsNew: Is Vincenzo DiBiasi (b. c.1866 Italy, widower, 1022 Bunker Hill St in 1940, son Michael b. c.1901) a brother of Maria Antonia? He could also be the father of Joseph DiBiasi (b. 1891, husband of her daughter Grace) and of Vincenzo 'James' DiBiase (b. 1894). The FamilySearch tree wrongly makes those two sons of Giovanni P. DiBiasi and Rosa Siconolfi, Maria Antonia's parents.
